title: Per-faction AI army role targets (V0)
notes: Role weights are permille of total troops and MUST sum to 1000.
min_role_counts are absolute minimums enforced before weight-closing (prevents all-one-role armies).
max_single_role_fraction_permille=650 is the anti-degeneracy ceiling for any one role.
Only four roles exist in ESoulUnitRole (Fighter/Ranged/SupportMagic/Apex); mapping is explicit.

Current AI factions ship only a single mono-unit pool (melee_line). The 'ranged'/'support'/'apex' weights are TARGETS that require MIG-2 (per-faction pools) before they can be met. Until MIG-2, the recruiter clamps to melee_line only and logs a 'role_pool_absent' reason — it must NOT silently pursue an impossible target.

Human founder values are grounded in VERIFIED runtime pool costs/stock so the AI pays the SAME prices the player does (parity requirement, VERIFIED in InitializeFourFactionAlpha which clones the human pool/cost/income to each AI faction).
Apex is intentionally rare and gated: at most 1 per army and only above a troop floor; it never substitutes for melee_line.
nature/dark are PASSIVE in the current four-faction game and are included only as inert future targets (NOT active recruiters). Do not activate them.

human_guard_pool.scope: Heartland only, requires operational human.barracks L2

verified_runtime_anchors.alpha_ai_pool_seed: Each AI faction receives a CLONE of the human_knight pool renamed to its own strategic unit (SoulFourFactionAlpha.cpp InitializeFourFactionAlpha). So dwarf/orc/viking each start with Available=8, WeeklyGrowth=4, Capacity=24, cost gold=140 of their mono-unit.
verified_runtime_anchors.alpha_recruit_target_floor: RunNextAlphaAction recruits while F.Army.TroopCount<30; urgent (<18) gets higher score.

orcs.note: Orc melee weight sits at the 650 ceiling-friendly 700 TARGET but is clamped to max_single_role_fraction_permille=650 at execution unless min_role_counts for other roles are already met. Aggressive doctrine favors earlier/larger recruit pushes.
